# Automate With Marwin

> AI & Workflow Automation Specialist — Marwin G. Emia builds n8n, Make.com, Zapier, and GoHighLevel workflows with AI integrations (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) to help agencies and growing businesses turn manual work into reliable, scalable systems.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Portfolio, services, process, case studies, and contact for AI and workflow automation work.
- [AI Receptionist case study](/case-studies/ai-receptionist): Vapi voice agent plus n8n speed-to-lead pipeline for a mortgage brokerage, live on a real inbound call within 24 hours.
- [Healthcare Front Desk case study](/case-studies/healthcare-front-desk): AI patient intake, LLM triage with human-review fallback, and real calendar booking, verified against execution logs.
- [DwinVideo case study](/case-studies/dwinvideo): AI-operated video editing pipeline. Transcription-driven cuts, karaoke captions, motion graphics as code, audio mastering.
- [AI Content Pipeline case study](/case-studies/content-pipeline): Four n8n workflows on one shared queue that take a dropped file to an AI-written draft, human review, Telegram approval, and a published post.
- [eCommerce Reconciliation case study](/case-studies/ecommerce-reconciliation): An n8n engine reconciling Shopify orders, Stripe payouts, and QuickBooks Online ledger entries against deterministic fee, refund, and deposit rules, flagging only the transactions that need a human decision.
- [ROI Calculator](/roi): Estimate the time and cost an automation would save.
